messages.subject: Project Drake — Port Solent landlord consent received
messages.plaintextBody:
Nathan,

Good news — the landlord of the Port Solent dry-stack site has given written consent to the change of control under clause 4.12 of the lease, dated today. That clears condition 4.1(a) in the SPA. A copy is going into the disclosure bundle. We remain on track for completion in mid-December.

Elena

—
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
